scientific_question: Do source islands with comparable island size and source population abundance differ in their next-year CONTRIBUTION of surviving recruits to other islands, conditional on habitat, destination demography and measured movement? Not a generic nearest-neighbor or source-count sign test.
overlap: Same Helgeland population as Ranke et al. 2021 (doi:10.1111/1365-2656.13580, 1993–2014); not a second archipelago or independent 2021 vs 2026 replicate. 2026 Hansson Frank et al. DOI 10.1002/ecy.70356 uses same long-term source.

published_design.2021: 11 islands, 1993–2014, 2,192 ringed recruits, 376 identified inter-island dispersers; movement size/distance/habitat already studied.
published_design.2026: 11 islands, 1994–2022, individual ID, year, island, stage and CMR survival/density analysis. Raw population N_corr is a derived posterior/model quantity.
published_design.known_island_occupancy_limitation: Most 11 islands occupied over most of study period, so true island-level 0→1 endpoints likely sparse. Need explicit 0→1 estimability check rather than inventing them.

confirmed_by_source_columns_if_headers_p: individual resighting time/marking island fields exist
island-year estimated population size columns exist
not_confirmed_by_header_alone: natal origin unambiguously known for every adult
individual reproductive descendants/parentage accessible in pinned files
distinction.flags: Identified ID at observation island does not imply observed migration unless same ID documented across islands with well-defined marking stage and detection. First observed island may differ from birth island.

inference_design.unit: Island-year rows nested within ONE archipelago, with dependence across common years, individual lineages and source/destination islands; 11 islands are not 29 independent archipelagos.
inference_design.retrospective_contrast: For a born-on-island, marked individual: identify natal ID only when nestling/juvenile provenance verified, check later destination and independent recruit/survival support. Evaluate source exporter contributions per production and corrected sampling effort, not movement counts alone.
inference_design.primary_future_test: Prediction of t+1 destination immigrant recruitment by pre-t viable natal source supply × independently observed historical directional dispersal transition operator after accounting for destination population density/food/habitat and distance. Do not use t+1 observed immigrants as t predictors.
inference_design.secondary: Per-immigrant reproductive value and whether the destinations persist when local recruitment is low, only if parentage, offspring survival and detection variables actually present.
inference_design.STOP: If birth-island identity, detection, true movement or lagged source operator cannot be verified, no immigrant-fitness or causal rescue claim. 0→1 only if enough actual empty-to-occupied islands across independent holdouts.
inference_design.independent_evidence_gate: 2026 & 2021 outcomes already published/context exposed; this can be retrospective only, never pristine confirmatory without new independent source; Structural v0.31/0.42 for future eligible systems only.
